title: Premium Accounting Refund Schedule: Premium Paid Beyond the Surrender Date of Whole Life Insurance
content:
Premium paid for whole months beyond the surrender effective date of an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy is refunded with the surrender, measured to the paid-to date, by the billing mode:

| Billing mode on the policy record | Refund |
|---|---|
| Quarterly | Whole months from the effective date to the paid-to date, times the installment premium, over 3 (the months in a quarterly installment's period) |
| Semiannual | Whole months from the effective date to the paid-to date, times the installment premium, over 6 |
| Annual | Whole months to the paid-to date, times the annual premium less the tier's annual policy fee, over **12** |
| Monthly EFT draft | Nothing |

Each refund is rounded half up to the cent, is added to the net amount paid, and is not part of the taxable amount.

A whole month is counted each time the same day of the month as the effective date is reached; the installment premium is the modal premium on the policy record, which on annual mode is the annual premium.

## Worked refunds (hypothetical, surrender effective July 10, 2025)

- Quarterly, installment premium 450.00, paid to September 1, 2025: 1 whole month (August 10); 450.00 over 3 is 150.00.
- Annual, annual premium 2475.00 on a tier with an annual policy fee of 75.00, paid to January 15, 2026: 6 whole months; 6 times 2400.00, over 12, is 1200.00.
- Monthly EFT, paid to August 1, 2025: nothing.
